# Natural Earth 1:110m land

Original GeoJSON, 127 land polygons including major islands; no political borders, roads or live data. Downloaded 2026-10-26 from the project maintainer's repository at pinned commit `693f11422f4e08d2da4566b854dda53eb7c39fb3`:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/693f11422f4e08d2da4566b854dda53eb7c39fb3/geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson

Data page: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/110m-physical-vectors/110m-land/

License: public domain. Primary terms verified 2026-10-26: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/ . Natural Earth permits modification and redistribution for personal, educational and commercial use, without permission or required attribution. Hole nevertheless displays “Made with Natural Earth.” No accuracy or navigation fitness is implied. The full upstream GeoJSON is retained unmodified; display projection happens locally.
